name: Robovox
_comment: Insert effect (vocoder for the Force's mic input). vst.json/module.json only feed mpc-vst-plugins' tools/gen_vst.py for params.h + the skin. The plugin is robovox_vst.cpp, built by this port's own build.sh (one source file, hand-written VST2 shell, no JUCE, no GUI; ALSA is opened at run time with dlopen for the MIDI-in port).
